column7: machine actors on nine human-only core ops (secret ACL grant, share, certificate, tags, description, move, copy, extend-expiring, access-request create) got an untyped "actor ID is required" validation error, which REST answered 400/500 and gRPC InvalidArgument/Internal (authzdiff waiver known-08). Fixed by refuseMachineActor (typed ErrPermissionDenied) and 403 mapping in the REST share/ACL/access-request handlers.
